data_description.scan_interval_season_hours: 15 May to 31 August, when readings arrive. Samples come about every 20 days, so checking more often mainly helps catch a short-notice closure.
data_description.scan_interval_offseason_hours: From September to mid-May nothing changes — last summer's readings and the annual rating stay as they are.
